about: A machine saved by the game as it was before the tower tubes, when a tower came up through a hatch in the pusher’s deck on a lift and gained its medals there (main at 08f27a03, storage version 9): written by that version’s own serialize, imported from a copy of main and not from this branch. A machine started from seed 20261014 had both rails held down from the start. Four seconds in it was paid twenty medals as towers, which stood built on the pusher by the end; nine seconds after that, sixty, three towers going up on their lifts; and two and six tenths of a second later forty more, two towers whose hatches had only begun to open, eighty paid loose for the hopper to pour, and a jewel let go from the hatch. It was saved six tenths of a second after that. Every medal it holds was still smaller than a medal is now.
